_guide: Navide development map, format navide-devmap/1. Agents: read this file right before you write it; edit groups, blocks and edges only; status is done|wip|plan; items are {kind: pr|plan, ref} where ref is a PR number or a file name in .agent-team/plans/; no coordinates, sizes or colors (layout is automatic); keep this _guide field.
